slice: GIS import transaction-scoped audit and location mapping
commands: python3 -m ruff check services/ingestion/gis_import.py tests/test_gis_import.py tests/test_geospatial_import_error_redaction.py tests/test_gis_import_audit_scope.py
verified: Location records map to their own location ID; farm records map to farm.location_id; plot records map through farm.location_id.
Success and failure audits use the same caller-owned database connection as geometry updates and include the resolved location scope.
Unknown targets receive a fixed failure message and null location scope; log output does not echo the source slug.
A failed geometry update rolls back to its savepoint and releases it so the transaction can continue.
Batch commit failure triggers rollback, and the connection closes on all tested exits.
external_effects: All database access was mocked. No database, provider, or candidate service was contacted.
limitations: No live PostgreSQL transaction or tenant authorization was exercised.
No populated legacy/candidate geometry fixture was compared.
